items.q: How has nationwide turnout in House races changed over the last five elections?
items.a: House races drew about 128 million votes in 2016, 113 million in 2018, 153 million in 2020, 107 million in 2022 and 148 million in 2024. Midterms run well below presidential years: 2018, the highest-turnout midterm in about a century, still came in 15 million votes under 2016, and 2022 drew about 41 million fewer House votes than 2024. The question tonight is whether 2026 lands closer to 2018 or to 2022.
